business_problem: Pinterest needed to serve multimodal AI experiences such as visual search, conversational shopping assistance, and ad optimization at internet scale, but doing that required much faster image understanding, lower inference cost, and higher visual context capacity than earlier serving stacks could provide.
solution_summary: Pinterest rebuilt its vision-language serving stack on NVIDIA Blackwell and NVIDIA Dynamo so images, text, and recommendation context could be processed together at platform scale. The system uses an internal image encoder to precompute visual embeddings, which Dynamo and vLLM then serve far more efficiently than raw-pixel inference for every request. That architecture powers Pinterest Assistant, multimodal reranking, content safety, and signal generation across a fleet of 14,000 GPUs spanning Blackwell, Hopper, and prior NVIDIA generations. Open models post-trained on Pinterest data now support shopping and discovery use cases at a fraction of prior transaction cost, while the same AI signals feed ad targeting, bidding, and creative optimization. By optimizing memory bandwidth, prefill, and visual-context handling on Blackwell, Pinterest turned its AI stack into a real-time discovery engine that connects inspiration, commerce, and monetization.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA Blackwell
solution_components.role: Provides the inference hardware foundation for large-scale vision-language workloads and Pinterest Assistant.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA Dynamo
solution_components.role: Serves precomputed visual embeddings and optimizes routing across Pinterest's VLM stack.

solution_components.name: vLLM
solution_components.role: Works with Dynamo to deliver efficient multimodal model serving for discovery and shopping features.

data_flow: User images, searches, boards, and intent signals are encoded into visual embeddings, served through Dynamo and vLLM, combined with text context inside VLMs, and returned as conversational assistance, reranking, safety signals, and ad-optimization outputs.
business_outcome: Pinterest supports 640 million monthly active users with a multimodal AI stack that runs at less than 8% of previous AI transaction costs, delivers a 6% click-through lift for AI creative optimization, processes 25x more visual context per request, and improves end-to-end latency by up to 44x.
